# HorseFil (horsefil.onrender.com)

> horsefil.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about HorseFil, a once-daily strawberry gummy dietary supplement for men. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's page and supplied photos)
- Form: strawberry gummy in a jar; the jar says "Support for your energy, vitality and performance"; seller's directions: one gummy per day; a bottle is described as a 30-day supply
- Named ingredients: maca root extract, rhodiola extract, grape seed extract, L-citrulline, L-carnitine, panax ginseng extract; no amounts given; the seller's headline says eight ingredients but lists six
- Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus $9.99 shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping); seller lists 60, 90 and 180 day supplies
- 60-day guarantee: contact support within 60 days; returns ship within 7 days of instructions; return shipping paid by the customer unless the item was wrong or damaged; refunds follow inspection (the seller's page also says "email for a refund" elsewhere)
- Not a treatment for erectile dysfunction, low testosterone or any disease; L-citrulline can interact with nitrates and erectile dysfunction drugs, rhodiola with antidepressants, and grape seed extract and ginseng with blood thinners
